data.name: Beth
data.gender_notes: Beth is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Beth is recorded in name-lists as “House of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Beth expresses “House of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Beth total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
